high_level_description: The image shows an outdoor scene at night, featuring a large red poster advertising an event called "Happy Space." The poster is prominently displayed on a grassy area with a yellow curb in the foreground. The poster has a festive design with images of clothing, accessories, jewelry, toys, organic essentials, handicrafts, and household items, suggesting that these will be available at the event. The text on the poster indicates that it is a "Pop Up Flea Market" organized by "Happy Space Events" and presented by "UPTOWN." The event dates are listed as from December 3rd, 2024,
